conventions.TODO_OWNER: Swift source comments require TODO(C03) / FIXME(C03) or a stable tracker ID such as TODO(PROJ-123). Dates alone do not identify work.
conventions.GUARD_IF_BLANK_LINE: Only a guard followed by if requires a blank line. Guard boundaries use balanced delimiters; adjacent guards and ordinary statements are allowed.
conventions.RETURN_BLANK_LINE: Review convention only. A blanket check after closing braces also catches valid return after guard-else-throw; do not add this as a linter rule.
conventions.LINEAR_IDENTITY_LOOKUP: Narrow regression guard for .first { $0.id/identity == ... } in layout/render. Not a complexity proof.
conventions.PUBLIC_DOCUMENTATION: Explicit public/open declarations, including properties and initializers, require Ownership/Isolation/Errors/Cancellation. This lexical check does not infer protocol requirements or implicit access from public extensions; review those surfaces as well.
conventions.SWIFT_LEXICAL: Masks comments and string literal text while preserving executable interpolations and line offsets. Not a full Swift parser; regex literals and macro expansion are outside this scanner contract.
conventions.PLATFORM_IMPORT: Native UI imports only in adapter source files under matching canImport guard. Core imports only Foundation. Shared code cannot use canImport or os conditions.
conventions.SOURCE_SCOPE: Swift architecture, documentation and style rules apply to Sources. Secrets scan all non-generated text; Markdown links scan documentation outside fenced examples. Fixture trees are excluded from normal scans and tested explicitly.
